text: Yes, built and made a permanent rule for all three accounts. How it works: the account whose slot (07:20 / 13:20 / 19:20 ET) began last owns the chat until the next slot. About 10 minutes before another account's slot, the current account tells you in the chat that the chat is moving (and to which account), releases the repo so that account's scheduled session can start, and keeps answering until the slot begins. Then it stands down: no work, no chat answers, no taking the lease, and if you do type in it, it tells you which account has the chat (say 'force' to take it back). The owner's scheduled session now stays on after its duty to answer your chat until its window ends. Safeguards: if the owning account is out of usage or its session never starts, nobody stands down, so the chat is never left unanswered. Honest status: tested on the logic only, not live yet. Right now the 13:20 account left no trace today, so I'm carrying on; the first real hand-over to this account is at 19:20 ET (23:20Z), and I'll tell you here how it goes. Rule is in CLAUDE.md and research/coordination/CHAT_OWNER.md.
